selection: sabre/xml 4.1.0 (Packagist 39,858,833), a package API over the libxml2 family: Sabre\Xml\Reader extends XMLReader and builds its own Clark-notation element tree. Both valid controls match the expat oracle on elements, attributes, depth, root and text.
uncertainty: Pilot cell, one verified third-party path. The earlier zero count wrongly excluded libxml2-family wrappers; PROTOCOL.md lets a wrapper qualify as a package API with its parser family identified, so sabre/xml is counted with family libxml2 (shared with the standard XMLReader path). symfony/dom-crawler and jms/serializer stay excluded because they only navigate or map an already parsed DOM/SimpleXML tree. The other libxml2-family wrappers (veewee/xml, mtownsend/xml-to-array, saloonphp/xml-wrangler, laravie/parser, orchestra/parser, pear/xml_parser and smaller ones) were not evaluated by the cutoff and remain unresolved, as do the own-code leads prewk/xml-string-streamer and watoki/dom. sabre/xml drops xmlns declarations and text in mixed-content elements by design, so its summary omits namespace declaration counts. Its coverage image uses Ubuntu PHP 8.5.4 with libxml 2.15.2; its AFL++ overlay uses the source-built PHP 8.5.12 and libxml2 2.15.4. The search covers the first 100 hits of five Packagist queries; controls are two small UTF-8 namespace-aware documents without DOCTYPE.
